confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge; live menus, listings and booking pages were not checked. Cafe and restaurant anchors are the firmest, while accommodation is least certain because rates vary by season, area and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine were set from general knowledge and cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.3x beer). The FX rate came from search-result summaries of the RBA site, not a directly opened page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned from comparable large Australian capital cities, chiefly Sydney, with cafe, bar and restaurant levels treated as broadly in line with them; accommodation set at July winter CBD and inner-suburb levels.
